verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill pack that runs inside AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, so users drive it through the agent's conversational interface. A root router skill "sends any gstack request to the right skill" (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, security, design), and a spec skill turns "vague intent" into an executable spec. A community user reports working through Claude-driven multiple-choice dialogues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that free-form natural-language requests (rather than slash-command skill invocation) reliably trigger the right workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of the routing accuracy.
